title: QCAD dxflib and DWG record-boundary evidence refresh
mode: primary-source web research and plan-only update
scope: Add a distinct, direction-limited open-source DXF comparator to the existing peer inventory
Refresh DWG reader record-boundary and coverage-denominator guidance from current project sources
Preserve fast local implementation cadence and existing external evidence boundaries

method.kind: Read current primary project documentation/source and cross-check against the existing local plan
method.limitations: QCAD dxflib feature and API pages establish documented route scope only; no exact peer revision was built or executed. dwg-rs and LibreDWG default-branch documentation is mutable and peer-reported coverage/maturity is not independent correctness evidence. No local format mismatch was reproduced.

sources.revision: Current QCAD feature page and mutable bundled API source, plus published dxflib 2.5 programmer guide; reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: dxflib is a callback-based C++ DXF reader/writer and does not retain a document model. QCAD lists supported-entity reading across DXF versions, explicit 3DFACE, and R15/AC1015 writing. It is not a DWG or ACIS/B-rep route.

sources.revision: Mutable README, coverage tool and clean-room note reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The pre-alpha ODA-spec-derived reader documents per-version decoded/skipped/error counts and exact record-boundary checks across legacy and modern stream profiles. Its own README warns against comparing aggregate coverage across changing corpora and records named decoder boundary failures.

sources.revision: Mutable current manual and fuzzing guidance reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The manual makes direction and maturity distinctions despite broad coverage prose, including no R2007 DWG writer and unstable/undertested, unhandled, and no-test-coverage classes. HACKING describes route-specific fuzz targets and recommends distinct values in DWG/DXF pairs for unknown-field analysis.

assessment.optionalComparatorAdded: QCAD dxflib, read-side DXF callback checks and limited AC1015 writer probe only
assessment.planImpact: Adds dxflib as a narrow optional DXF comparator and makes record-boundary provenance plus fixed per-version/per-type denominators explicit when interpreting DWG peer evidence. No new local implementation task or mandatory validation is justified.

implementationReadyChecks: Select one exact local format/version/direction/record-family question before considering any peer.

For each changed DWG reader profile, identify the authoritative version-specific record boundary and separately account for string and handle streams when exposed; do not invent boundaries where the local parser cannot establish them.
Use stable input hashes and report decoded, skipped, error, not-exercised, and transformed outcomes per file/version/type; do not compare aggregate percentages across different corpora.
Use dxflib only for a matching DXF callback-read question or verified AC1015 write question; do not treat QCAD as an additional parser lineage if the route uses dxflib.
Keep all peer, fuzz, native, sanitizer, and full-suite work at existing composed gates; local implementation slices retain generated controls and one focused selector/owning CTest.
Do not import or commit external peer/customer DWG/DXF fixtures; use repository-owned or locally authored temporary controls.
